fact_check_rounds.label: Round 1: the 40 profiled plants (after the parallel list audit)
Round 2: confirming round, all 47 profiled plants, checkers rotated (after the sweep)

miss_rate.value: 38/126 = 30.2% (verified; both auditors); up to 46/134 = 34.3% with 8 unverified
miss_rate.note: The blind list audit ran in parallel with the finders, so every verified miss was added before profiling was chosen. Two-list (capture-recapture) estimate of the population the auditors' search methods reach: about 132 plants. Three closure passes then reconciled EPA's registries for mining machinery (333131), construction machinery (333120) and conveying equipment (333922) and added 14, 24 and 46 base plants. The best-scoring plant (Process Machinery, Shelbyville KY) came from closure, so the list has not converged; the miss rate is not re-measured after closure.

known_limits: Partial: the bounded final closure pass added 46 base plants, four with a dated welder posting on the company's own board naming the site (Exodus Superior WI, PPI Lenox IA, Syntron Saltillo MS, West River Oakwood VA), so the list has not converged. 121 EPA registry rows (333120 and 333922) are still unverified, 102 of them not researched.

Fact-check: round 1 found 11.4% of checked claims needed correction (mostly company-level facts shown at one site); after a pattern sweep, the rotated round 2 over all 47 profiles found 3.3%. All corrections are applied.
Material scores 0 on most profiled plants: mining and construction sources rarely state a welded part's size or weight, and payloads, bucket capacities and machine classes do not count as part sizes.
Only 47 of 279 included plants are profiled; base records carry no score.
EPA FRS was down (503) during parts of the finder stage; some registry quotes were checked only by the finders.
